value.rationale: The family \(qm^2\) for squarefree \(m\) and prime \(q\nmid m\) is an intrinsic, variable-prime-support low-exponent stratum of a published equality question. The result uniformly excludes all \(k\ge2\) repeated-prime supports and identifies the only positive singleton boundary, using a strict cofactor inequality, quadratic-residue obstruction and \(2\)-adic rigidity. The known equality \(6615=3^3\cdot5\cdot7^2\) exhibits higher-support equality after allowing exponent three, making the exponent restriction meaningful.
